frameworks.summary: DarbotLM Kokoro 0.9.4 KPipeline with a shared KModel on CPU, CUDA, or MPS. Weighted blends are pre-mixed tensors, not torch.mean. Local files are preferred; download only if GEN_AUDIO_ALLOW_HF_DOWNLOAD=1.

DarbotLM kokoro-onnx 0.6.1 supports timed, streaming and duration-export continuous synthesis, explicit ONNX providers, pause controls, and voice blends. Files come from GEN_AUDIO_KOKORO_MODEL and GEN_AUDIO_KOKORO_VOICES.

DarbotLM Misaki 0.9.4+py315.1 supports English, Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Vietnamese, and eSpeak G2P. transformer is false on Python 3.15.2. custom_entries are merged into lexicon.golds. This row does not emit a waveform.
VibeVoice long-form TTS. 1.5B and 7B support explicit CPU, DirectML, CUDA, or hybrid execution policy with bounded memory placement and raw GENAID voice WAV references.
VibeVoice-Realtime presets. Not runnable until weights exist and model_revision is pinned. Load with torch.load weights_only=true. experimental is every file prefix except built-in en and in.

Local nvidia/personaplex-7b-v1 speech-to-speech through an isolated BF16 hybrid Moshi worker and DLM Speech. Uses mono 24 kHz PCM16 input and raw voice WAV references; bundled .pt prompt pickles are never loaded.
